subject: Sparkline expansion — multi-app keys and addendum coordination
messages:
From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@magnushealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@magnushealth.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Add 3 product teams (keys + term change)

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profile and the per-route observability. We’re ready to push forward and would like to add three additional product teams to our account (Search UX, Billing Bots, and Clinical Integrations). High level asks: 1) separate API keys for each team, 2) quota enforcement per key, and 3) a short-term amendment that increases our committed capacity (current contract line items +20% for Q1).

Attached is a simple list of the apps and expected monthly token volumes. Can you confirm next steps and timeline for issuing keys and what an addendum would look like? Procurement (copied) will need the pricing delta and whether this affects our existing renewal terms.

App list: Magnus_Search_UI, Magnus_Billing_Bot, Magnus_Clinical_Connector

Thanks,
Tom Ellis
Head of Product Operations
Magnus Health

[Attachment: Magnus_Requested_App_List.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 45KB)]

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@magnushealth.com>
Cc: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@magnushealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Add 3 product teams (keys + term change)

Hi Tom — great to hear. Happy to run the coordination. Quick outline of next steps so everyone has visibility:

1) Confirm volumes & app owners (we'll use the attached list as a starting point). Monica — can you validate expected concurrency and the preferred isolation model (dedicated namespace vs shared with key-level quotas)?
2) Pricing & addendum draft — Lauren, we'll need a short addendum that covers +20% committed capacity for Q1 and the separate keying. Recommend keeping renewal date unchanged and adding a 12-week ramped credit so Magnus isn't double-billed during rollout.
3) Key issuance & governance — Rishi, I'll need guidance on key naming conventions and any limits we should surface in the console for the Magnus SREs.
4) Timeline — target keys issued by 10/22, addendum sent for signature by 10/26, rollout to follow in two waves (Search UI + Billing Bot first).

Tom — if that timeline works I'll prepare a short mutual action plan and a draft addendum for legal & procurement review. Also attaching a quick internal checklist for rollout items.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Sparkline-rollout-checklist.pdf (application/pdf, 18KB)]

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: Add 3 product teams (keys + term change)

Folks — forwarding Tom's request and my note. Need quick alignment on the commercial and technical approach before I share the addendum with Magnus procurement. Key questions:

- Commercial: keeping renewal date the same (no extension) but add a Q1 committed +20% line item; we should recommend a 12-week ramp credit structure to reduce churn risk during activation. Any objections?
- Legal: can we use the standard short-form addendum template or do you want a bespoke clause for per-key quotas?
- Technical: Monica, do we recommend dedicated namespaces for Search UI and Clinical Integrations (data isolation concern mentioned by client) or can quota enforcement by API key suffice? Also need expected lead time to create keys, optional SSO/SCIM for team mappings.

I've started a draft addendum (see attachment) — I'll iterate based on your comments and then send to Tom + procurement.

Thanks — please reply with short bullets so I can turn this into an internal decision and keep the client moving.

--Camila

[Attachment: MA-Redwood-Addendum-Draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 56KB)]

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@magnushealth.com>, Magnus Health Procurement <procurement@magnushealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Sparkline expansion — mutual action plan and addendum (next steps)

Tom / Sara — thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is the short mutual action plan and the draft addendum reflecting the +20% committed capacity for Q1 and separate API keys for each new team. Summary of next steps:

1) Review & sign: draft addendum attached. We can route via DocuSign — link included below. Target signature by 10/26.
2) Key issuance: once procurement signs, we'll issue three scoped API keys (one per app) and set quotas as discussed. Keys will be visible in your account console under "Team Keys". Estimated delivery: 10/22.
3) Rollout waves: Wave 1 (Search UI + Billing Bot) scheduled for 10/28–11/04; Wave 2 (Clinical Integrations) scheduled for 11/08–11/15. Monica will own operational validation and SRE handoff.
4) Billing / credits: we've included a 12-week ramp credit in the addendum so you'll see prorated usage credits for the new teams during activation. Lauren — legal & billing items are documented in section 3 of the addendum.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/recipient-link/example-addendum-123
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/9876543

Please reply with any redlines or whether you'd prefer to schedule a 30-minute procurement call this week. If I don't hear back, I'll assume the timeline above and queue the addendum for routing on Thursday.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0142 | camila_reyes@redwood.com
